data.gender_notes: Ramlakhan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ram means god and Lakhan means wealth. So, Ramlakhan is a name which means 'God of Wealth'. The name Ramlakhan carries the meaning “God Ram” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Ramlakhan usually hope their child will grow to embody god ram and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ramlakhan is a name which represents the divine presence of God Ram, who is believed to be the god of wealth and prosperity in Hindu mythology.
data.etymology: Ramlakhan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God Ram.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramlakhan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ramlakhan signifies the Hindu belief in the influence of gods in everyday life, particularly in matters related to wealth and prosperity. In Hindu mythology, Lord Ram is often shown as the god of righteousness and strength, while Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, is usually depicted guiding him. The name Ramlakhan could represent the fusion of these two concepts, emphasizing the importance of both wealth and virtue in one's life.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Ramlakhan lies in its symbolism of seeking material wealth while remaining rooted in spiritual values. It's a reminder for individuals to recognize that true wealth comes not only from material possessions but also from within, through inner peace, contentment, and morality. The name encourages the holder to be devoted to their spiritual pursuits, while also striving for earthly success, thus achieving a balanced and fulfilling life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ramlakhan: God Ram, the all-powerful, inside the fortress of the heart (Lakhan).

historical_references.reference: Ramlakhan was a famous Jain monk and the spiritual teacher of the Rajput king Jai Singh II in the late 17th century.
Ramlakhan was also an important figure in the Jain community during the medieval period. He established several Jain temples and wrote commentaries on Jain scriptures.

It is believed to be the name of Lord Rama's brother Lakshmana, who is known for his unwavering loyalty and strength. In modern contexts, this name is often used in various art forms, festivals, and cultural celebrations.
